lines: When the full moon rises, the wilds offer no refuge. Nothing remains but hunter and prey.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Lone Wolf

lines: There were never any walls in this world. As long as you're strong enough, everything you see is a road.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Mammoth

lines: Need something wrecked? We do it all. Every coin you spend will become someone else's uninvited disaster, guaranteed.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Witch Rat

lines: Light nurtures us. Light shelters us. We are the sun incarnate. We are the law of day.

lines: The moon is far beyond reach, yet its edge can still come for you.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Blade of the Silver Moon

lines: Keep running. Faster.
Only when the prey had exhausted its last ounce of strength did she leap down gracefully from the towering cliff.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Relentless Claws

lines: A clear, piercing howl rides the wind, making you think the night holds only one lone wolf. But when you turn toward the sound, you may find yourself already snared in her trap.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Howl of the Pack

lines: Very well. This time, I will bear it all.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Iron Curtain

lines: A true king commands supreme might, shattering all that is unbreakable and crushing all that is unreasonable.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Wild Barbarian King

lines: The wounds on this massive body have never truly healed, and from them surges a boundless torrent of strength. Whoever claims his armor inherits his power. And his pain.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Vessel of Sin

lines: Dying alone's the old-school way. Down in the sewers, numbers win. So, you in?
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Curl-Tailed Sentinel

lines: Easy, easy. No need to rush. Let me just set loose a few starving black rats... and a plague that creeps in silence.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Plague

lines: Enough talk! Eat this arrow!
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Rampaging Rat

lines: A golden wall towering over the scorched earth, keeping usurpers' ambitions at bay.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Golden-Mane Bastion

lines: Neither ritual nor crown bequeaths our authority. My lineage, ancient and luminous, commands by birthright a majesty that makes everything unclean recoil.
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Scion of Light

lines: From the grasslands beneath our feet, we trample cities and thrones, charging ceaselessly toward the boundless lands touched by the blazing sun!
entries.name: Recommendation Letter - Chant of Conquest
